name: router
title: Multi-page routing
summary: React Router with lazy pages, correct scroll on every navigation (top, #hash, Back restores), a 404 page and the Vercel SPA rewrite.
when: The brief needs more than one page (about, work, pricing, legal, a form on its own URL). A single long page does not need it.
next: Replace your App's body with <BrowserRouter><ScrollManager /><Routes>…</Routes></BrowserRouter>; see packs/router/README.md for the full snippet.
Use <Link> for internal links and followSectionLink (utils/page-scroll) for same-page #section links.
